messages:
incident-bot: [PAGE] 3335556666 - high cross-region routing churn detected. metric: latency-steer-flips/minute = 12 (threshold 1). severity: page. link: https://ops.redwood.internal/alerts/3335556666
marta: oncall here. seeing eu requests flip between eu-pool and us-pool every ~20s, causing client retry storms and elevated 5xx. who owns latency-steering service?
jon: I'm on latency-steer service. looks like the steering decision window is oscillating because a subset of probe nodes in eu reported transient 600ms p95 to eu-backend, causing heuristic to prefer us-pool. then us-pool gets saturated -> latency rises -> steer snaps back.
deepak: that matches traces. sample: request-id=abc-123 -> first hop eu-pool 210ms, next batch routed to us-pool 920ms, client retried -> higher error.
marta: plan A (fast): 1) disable automatic latency-steering for eu until stable 2) place short-lived strong pin eu->eu-pool 3) scale eu pool if capacity shows CPU/GPU saturation. will run in that order. jon, can you flip steer off?
jon: disabling adaptive latency steering for region eu now: ```POST https://controlplane.internal/v1/steering/regions/eu/actions -d '{"action":"disable_adaptive_steer","reason":"incident-3335556666"}'```
deploy-bot: action accepted -> action-id act-552. propagation start. expected convergence 30s.
ops-bot: system note: automated alert suppression enabled for incident-3335556666 to avoid alert storm.
marta: applying pin override after steer off: ```curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/v1/route-override -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"selector":"eu","target":"eu-pool","ttl":120,"priority":"emergency"}'```
deploy-bot: override created -> ovr-2201. propagation ~40s.
ash: (typo) meant ash: scaling eu pool by +2 instances (scale-signal=manual) to absorb retries. kicking now.
ash/ash: scaling command: ```./infractl scale --pool eu-pool --delta 2 --reason "incident-3335556666"```
deploy-bot: scale job queued job-7701. estimated spin-up 90s.
deepak: telemetry after steer off + override: routing stable to eu-pool, 5xx down 80% vs peak, p95 latency at eu 140ms. us-pool load dropping. good initial signal.
marta: keep override for 3 minutes to allow caches and probes to settle. jon please hold on enabling steering until we patch thresholds.
jon: ack. creating rollback/patch ticket for steering threshold regression and probe weighting: TKT-3335556666. patch will add hysteresis and min-stability window (30s).
nia: CS here, seeing inbound tickets from two EU customers complaining about high error spikes ~02:34 UTC. I'll draft a proactive message: short summary, mitigation applied, ETA for full postmortem. hold sending until we have stable metrics for 10m.
marta: agreed. please include temporary mitigation steps customers can take (increase client retry backoff).
jon: digging into causes: probe node set in eu had a misconfiguration (probe-source list included a flakey edge in us-east due to recent inventory sync). operator change earlier today added wildcard that matched and bumped its weight. that caused bad sample to skew steering.
deepak: logs show operator promotion at 3335556400 which included probe config change. saving diffs now.
marta: good. next actions: - keep override until 3335556980 (3m) - collect probe logs and operator diffs - open PR to tighten probe selection and add probe-health gating - coordinate with infra to restore the correct probe list - prepare postmortem and customer note.
jon: adding temporary probe whitelist to avoid the flakey edge: ```PATCH https://controlplane.internal/v1/probes/eu -d '{"whitelist":["eu-edge-*","eu-probe-*"]}'```
deploy-bot: probe whitelist applied -> job-8822.
ash/ash: eu scale up completed at 3335556735. instances healthy.
deepak: operator rollback to prior probe config queued (rollback-id rb-101). doing dry-run validation.
marta: once operator rollback completes, we'll remove route override. raj (not present) usually checks DNS TTLs, but we don't have raj oncall. jon, can you verify DNS / cache status in eu edges?
jon: checking: some edge caches still hold previous route mapping for up to 210s due to intermediate CDNs. we've used a low TTL on override, but need to eject caches via purge endpoint: ```POST https://edge-api.internal/v1/purge -d '{"pattern":"/route-map/eu/*"}'```
deploy-bot: purge started. propagation ~60s.
ops-bot: auto-silenced low-priority alerts related to cache TTL drift.
ash/ash: operator rollback completed at 3335556760, probe config restored to stable. canary checks OK.
deepak: metrics: steer flips/minute = 0.4, eu 5xx ~0.8% (baseline 0.5). acceptable.
marta: remove override at 3335556790: ```DELETE https://controlplane.internal/v1/route-override/ovr-2201```
deploy-bot: override ovr-2201 removed. propagation started.
marta: leaving steering disabled until we merge patch with hysteresis. jon please own that patch. deepak capture logs/diffs to /tmp/incidents/3335556666/. nia prepare customer note once we have 30m stable metrics. I'll assign postmortem owner and timeline.
nia: prepared external draft and hold until go-ahead. draft includes: incident summary, affected customers, mitigation, ETA for full report within 72 hours.
jon: opening postmortem doc INC-3335556666-PM. tagging eng-runtime, eng-platform, eng-sre.
deploy-bot: incident closed in alerting system. please escalate if any regressions observed.
marta: assigning jon as postmortem lead, deepak as telemetry owner, ash to validate infra scaling, nia for customer comms. thanks team. :thumbsup:
